narrative.headline: The decision tree is driven mainly by nr.employed, cons.conf.idx and cons.price.idx.
narrative.body: The five macro-economic indicators together account for 78% of the model's attribution — it is largely reading the state of the economy at the time of the call. nr.employed, cons.conf.idx and cons.price.idx are the top three. day_of_week ranks 7 of 20 (2.7% of attribution), consistent with its nearly flat subscription rate in the EDA. Because the tree is shallow, most features get exactly zero attribution for most clients — they never appear on that client's path.
narrative.caveat: SHAP shows what the model uses, not what causes subscription. A feature can have high SHAP importance and no causal relationship with the outcome.
